summary: TradeOS Mobile Experience v1.0 — frontend-only smoke on iPhone 14 Pro viewport (390x844) after login as inbox@twofungis.ca. Verified: (1) bottom nav bar is fully removed on mobile (no fixed bottom nav element found), (2) hamburger button in AppLayout header opens a full-height slide-out drawer with backdrop and 48x48 touch target, (3) all drawer nav items (Home, Opportunities, Projects, Estimating, Financial, Expenses, Documents, Reports, Integrations, Settings, My Profile, Sign Out) use min-h-[48px] and render inside a 320px drawer, (4) Opportunities page renders as mobile-optimised cards + search, no horizontal overflow (doc scrollWidth=clientWidth=390), New Opportunity CTA is 326x48, (5) Projects page 'Create Project'/'New Project' button opens the New Project modal correctly on mobile, (6) Production Library (Estimating) mobile navigation drawer opens correctly showing Production Standards / Knowledge Domains / Assemblies / Service Categories / Import Library. FAIL: Production Library CONTENT overflows horizontally on mobile — document scrollWidth=1184 vs clientWidth=390, forcing the entire app shell (AppLayout main wrapper) to be 1184px wide. Root cause is a missing min-w-0 on the AppLayout flex child, combined with the list-view rows using fixed pixel column widths that require ~900px. Additionally two touch targets slightly under-spec (40px vs 44px).

ui_bugs.issue: Missing min-w-0 on the flex child. On mobile, when a nested page has wide fixed-width content (Production Library list rows), the flex-1 wrapper grows to fit content, forcing the entire viewport to scroll horizontally (documentElement.scrollWidth=1184 vs clientWidth=390). This defeats the workspace's own overflow-auto container.
ui_bugs.selector: div.flex-1.flex.flex-col.min-h-screen (child of the root <div class='min-h-screen bg-black flex'> in AppLayout.jsx line ~204)

ui_bugs.issue: List rows use fixed pixel widths (w-28 code + w-36 domain + w-16 unit + w-24 rate + w-20 output + w-24 usage + w-8 + flex-1 name) totaling ~900px. On a 390px viewport the row cannot shrink and no horizontal scroll is offered inside the workspace pane — instead the entire page scrolls horizontally. Requirement 'Production Library content is scrollable without horizontal overflow' is NOT met. Consider (a) switching to a card/stacked layout on mobile like Opportunities, or (b) forcing the items container to overflow-x-auto with a min-width table so scroll is trapped inside the pane.
ui_bugs.selector: [data-testid='production-library-workspace'] .flex-1.overflow-auto > div (list header/rows around line 907-1000 of ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx)

ui_bugs.issue: The workspace's own hamburger button is 40x40px which is below the 44-48px min touch target requirement stated in the spec ('all touch targets should be minimum 44px height'). AppLayout's hamburger is correctly 48x48. Recommend bumping to w-11 h-11 (44px) or w-12 h-12 (48px).
The 'New Project' CTA in the Projects page header is 151x40 on mobile — 40px height is below the 44px min touch target. In-modal 'Create Project' submit is fine (larger). Bump button to min-h-[44px].

integration_issues.issue: First fetch after SIGNED_IN throws 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' at /api/command-center (also reported in iteration_26). Still present. Console noise, doesn't block UI.

issues: Table columns extend well past viewport (C001, C002 rows show Standard Name + STAND(ARD) badge clipped mid-word).
Header 'Production Library' title is hidden below sm breakpoint (hidden sm:block), leaving only the library icon — the mobile header feels bare. Consider showing the title on mobile too.

action_items: PRIMARY FIX: In /app/frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout.jsx line ~204, add 'min-w-0' to the main content flex wrapper: change <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-screen"> to <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-screen min-w-0">. This will let child pages honour their own overflow-x-auto and stop the whole app shell from being pushed wider than the viewport on mobile.

SECONDARY FIX: In /app/frontend/src/pages/app/ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx (around line 907-1000), give the list-view container a mobile-friendly layout — either wrap the rows in a div with overflow-x-auto + a min-width on the header/rows so scroll is trapped inside the pane, OR switch to a stacked card layout at <lg (mirroring the Opportunities pattern).
TERTIARY: bump the workspace hamburger (line ~2298 of ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx) from w-10 h-10 to w-11 h-11 or w-12 h-12 to hit the 44px min touch target.
TERTIARY: bump [data-testid='new-project-btn'] in ProjectsPage.jsx line ~185 to include min-h-[44px] — currently 40px on mobile.
OPTIONAL: unhide the 'Production Library' title on <sm (currently 'hidden sm:block' on line 2309) so mobile users see a title in the workspace header.
OPTIONAL: investigate the /api/command-center 'Failed to fetch' error still surfacing post-login (carried over from iteration_26).
critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout.jsx: The main content wrapper is missing 'min-w-0' — a very common Tailwind flexbox trap. Every page inside <Outlet /> is at the mercy of a single misbehaving fixed-width child. Add min-w-0 defensively.

ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx is 2381 lines and still houses navigation, list, grid, domains, categories, assemblies, detail panel, command palette and modal in one file — >3x the 700-line guideline. This makes the mobile pass painful because responsive fixes ripple through many concerns. Recommend splitting into LeftNavigation.jsx, ProductionStandardsList.jsx, DomainsView.jsx, AssembliesView.jsx, CommandPalette.jsx, DetailPanel.jsx.

Touch target spec is stated as 'minimum 44-48px height' but two obvious controls (workspace hamburger 40px, ProjectsPage new-project 40px) miss it. A quick eslint rule / audit hook enforcing min-h-[44px] on button/link elements in the workspace routes would prevent regression.

The AppLayout desktop-sidebar-only aside uses 'hidden lg:flex' which is fine, but the mobile drawer duplicates the entire navItems / bottomNavItems render logic. Extract into a shared <NavigationList /> component to avoid drift when adding new sections.

success_rate.frontend: 6/8 core features fully PASS, 1 FAIL (Estimating horizontal overflow), 1 PARTIAL (workspace hamburger touch target)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Test at 390x844 viewport. All mobile assertions above ran against the deployed URL https://profit-tracker-demo-1.preview.emergentagent.com. The single blocking issue is horizontal overflow on /app/estimating — DO NOT retest it until AppLayout gets min-w-0 AND ProductionLibraryWorkspace list-view is made responsive (either card-stack or trapped horizontal scroll). Everything else (bottom-nav removal, drawer, opportunities responsive, projects modal) is passing. To reproduce the overflow: login → navigate to /app/estimating → run `document.documentElement.scrollWidth` in DevTools console → expect 1184.
rca of the issue: Horizontal overflow on Estimating (Production Library) at mobile viewport: (a) AppLayout's flex row does NOT set min-w-0 on the '<div class=flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-screen>' child, so flex default min-width:auto lets the child grow to its content's intrinsic width. (b) ProductionLibraryWorkspace list-view rows sum fixed-width columns (w-28 + w-36 + w-16 + w-24 + w-20 + w-24 + w-8 + gap-4 + flex-1) to ~900px. (c) The workspace's own overflow-auto on the items pane can't rescue the layout because the parent chain already grew past viewport. Fix requires BOTH min-w-0 at AppLayout (structural) AND a responsive list layout inside the workspace (list should either become card-stack on <lg or force min-w on the inner scroll container so overflow-x-auto actually kicks in). Reproduction: /app/estimating at 390x844 → document.documentElement.scrollWidth === 1184.
